gates.result: The isolated new-application review database contains exactly 50 latest confirmed records for L7-001 through L7-050, no replacement requests, contiguous version histories, 100 rehashed package images, and no structural validation errors. This gate makes no OCR or accuracy claim.

The real locked set preserves its natural distribution. The four deterministic relationship scenarios reuse human-confirmed real-image roles, execute the production assess_ticket_roles policy, require exact awaiting-review issue codes, and are excluded from real counts, confusion matrices, latency, accuracy, recall, and prevalence claims.

Formal report persistence rejects inconsistent observed pair outcomes, unsupported runner versions, incomplete or changed run contexts, stale request hashes, boolean schema-version impersonation, and the reviewed partial-row false-positive forgery through normal, replayable, and idempotent read paths. This gate does not claim protection against a privileged actor coherently rewriting the entire SQLite database and every self-hash.

The fail-closed export bridge, configured server-side reviewer identity, formal package bind and validation, perceptual-similarity decisions, qualified CPU/GPU OCR evaluation, and independent review of actual formal results remain incomplete. Loop 7 and real accuracy claims remain pending.
